neighbours.label: a medical procedure that ties, bands or closes off a vessel or tube (ligation, suture, clip, rubber band), firing up to the closing device, as opposed to procedures that open, widen or inspect the same vessels
fire: During the operation the bleeding artery was tied off with a silk thread.
In a vasectomy each duct is cut and sealed with a small clip.
To control the hemorrhage the surgeon ligated the vein with a stitch.
The leaking vessel was closed off with a metal clip before the wound was washed.
Varicose veins may be tied off through small cuts in the leg.
The uterine artery was clamped and then tied with a heavy suture.
Internal hemorrhoids are often treated by banding them with an elastic ring.
The bile duct was occluded with a titanium clip during the removal.
quiet: During the operation the narrowed artery was widened with a soft balloon.
In a colonoscopy the bowel is viewed and filmed with a small camera.
To check the blockage the surgeon imaged the vein with a scanner.
The narrowed vessel was held open with a metal stent before the wound was washed.
Varicose veins may be examined through ultrasound of the leg.
The uterine artery was located and then measured with a fine probe.
Internal hemorrhoids are often diagnosed by viewing them with a short scope.
The bile duct was dilated with a plastic tube during the examination.

short: tying or closing off a vessel in a procedure
notes: Card: tubal ligation, rubber band ligation, permanent suture, shunting, tourniquet on function words. Output: this pole promotes lig, cl, oc, emb, clamp, tying; the + pole promotes dilation, per-, percutaneous and fires on catheter text, so the two poles are the two sides of closing versus opening. Probes: tied off with a 1.42-1.52, closed off with a 1.02, tubes are 1.15, rubber band 0.86; opened with a 0.18, angioplasty 0.05, balloon 0.10, examined 0.02, plumber tied off 0.38.
